scope: Implementation replay of author controls in a disposable copy. Checksums and finite diagnostics do not prove mathematics or contribution.

copy.authenticated_before_use: author verify.py with external anchor 38b748ab81407bdb6bbd6b8557fc9f4d27fc094884705e8fcd9963939c4907fd: PASS (62 payloads, 17 dirs, 31 blobs, 2 pairs); zero anchor rc=1
copy.env: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1, python3 -B (prevents __pycache__ inside the copied root)

integrity_controls.reason_check: Each rejection reason was compared with the mutation: anchor cases -> external manifest anchor mismatch; content edits -> payload mismatch naming the edited file; missing/extra file -> exact file inventory mismatch; empty dir -> exact directory inventory mismatch; symlink/fifo -> symlink or nonregular node naming the node; hardlink -> hardlinked regular file naming the first-scanned link (checkpoint.md, sorted before report.md); nested manifest -> nested manifest. All consistent.
integrity_controls.limitation: The script derives its anchor from the copy's own MANIFEST.json; changed_scope_status is rejected at the payload-hash step, so the scope-pin line is not exercised. Scratch is removed afterwards; post-run verify of the copy PASS.

extra_scope_pin_control.method: fresh cp -a copy; append to original-scope.txt; rewrite its MANIFEST entry; verify

finite_diagnostics.limits: No finite-presentation compiler execution, no universal theorem or novelty validation.
